newsitem.title: USA: Crawford boosts payouts, splits stock.
newsitem.headline: Crawford boosts payouts, splits stock.

text.p: Crawford & Co said Wednesday it has declared quarterly dividends of $0.165 per share on its Class A and Class B common stock, up from $0.15 and $0.14 respectively and payable February 25 to shareholders of record as of the close of business February 14.
This represents increases of 10 percent on the Class A common stock and 13.8 percent on the Class B common stock over the prior dividend rates, the company said.
In addition, the company declared a three-for-two stock split on Class A and Class B common shares in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend, payable March 25 to shareholders of record on March 11.
The company also said that its annual meeting will be held on March 6.
